Do you know anyone in Arizona? Research shows that reminders from friends and family to vote have a bigger effect on turnout than anything campaigns do. One of the best ways you can help is to scroll through your contacts (or use apps like VoteWithMe) to find people you can check in with to see if they plan to vote or need help doing it.
